prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted actual impact, while negative or zero forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.9% and -9.0%).
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 10 tests, despite 2 winning tests (+3.6% and +6.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced highly inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Voice Tone Selector Sub-Flow: Add an interactive sound component to the companion selection screen allowing users to preview pet vocal tones. (why: Support receives confusion emails about how to talk to or hear pets after onboarding; early sound interaction sets communication expectations.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Inspection Screen: Insert a new pet inspection screen immediately after photo upload for users to review their custom pet render before adoption. (why: Users submitted 3 support tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong; previewing reduces post-adoption rendering surprises.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Existing Pet Account Hint: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in with an existing account restores lost pets and saved desktop data. (why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in with a secondary account.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Slot Visual: Add an animated desktop slot indicator component to the waiting screen while background pet files prepare. (why: Waiting step median duration is 201s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop upon app launch.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Before Desktop Generation: Move account sign-in after pet adoption certification, right before desktop pet generation begins. (why: Adoption drop-off is 78.8%; allowing users to select and customize their companion first increases investment before asking for sign-in.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Launch Opt-In Notification: Enable ready notification opt-in prompt with explicit ready notification toggle on the waiting screen. (why: Home wait stage has a mean time of 2336s; notifying users when processing finishes lets them safely background the app.)
6: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout: Switch adoption certificate layout to stage format featuring an official pet companion badge. (why: Reinforces companion ownership right before the generation wait step to reduce exit rate prior to final desktop launch.)

scores.note: New sub-flows in adoption step historically underperform (-7.1%).
Adding extra screens consistently hurts funnel conversion.
Solves largest support complaint via simple text config.
Wait info updates yield minor positive average historical lift (+1.8%).
Delays friction of sign-in, targeting high adoption drop-off.
Helps users handle long wait times (2336s mean duration).
Layout tweak targets high adoption drop step (21.2% drop) safely.
